# Aim trainer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/aim-trainer/

Practice clicking or tapping targets and review accuracy in a timed round. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Play a 20-second round with targets of a chosen size and compare hits with total clicks.

## Limits and checks

This is a local practice game. Scores depend on screen size and input method and are not comparable to a standardized esports benchmark.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
